_comment: Haymitch's District 12. Device: the insert. A tactile detail fills the screen before the photo it belongs to: fingers on a small handmade trinket, a stained shirt and worn cuff before Haymitch walks to the reaping, the geese before Lenore Dove and Haymitch. Around them, the district: the girls' side of the reaping, light through a doorway, the fence wire, a house burning. The poster portrait holds on bar 5, then the same boy stares out of the reaping crowd, which loops back to his hands. Only one photo is of the couple.

_tempo_comment: 90 BPM, 6 bars, 16.0 s, 20 frames per beat. Post with an intimate acoustic or folk sound at 90 (45 half time). Bar 5 (10.67 s) is the anchor portrait: put the vocal entrance or the first big chord there.
